name: CWC Southern States Championship
epitaph: The Southern region's own top singles title, held by Tommy Lane before it moved to the Georgia region in the council's own restructuring.

name: CWC Southern States Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Southern region's own tag title, held by the Polo Club before it moved to the Georgia region, and later defended by the Hot House against the New British Lions.

name: CWC Tennessee Championship
epitaph: A secondary Southern region singles title, held by the Carolina Crusher.

name: CWC Mid-South Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A new title created for Tommy Lane when the Southern region was renamed Mid-South Wrestling.

name: CWC Mid-South Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A new tag title created for the Electric Mayhem when the Southern region was renamed Mid-South Wrestling.

name: CWC Mid-Atlantic Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The Mid-Atlantic region's own top singles title, won by Rex Stone in a six-man battle royal after the belt sat vacant.

name: CWC Mid-Atlantic Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Mid-Atlantic region's own tag title, held by FREEK and Static Rule.

name: CWC Florida Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The Mid-Atlantic region's own Florida-branded singles title, held by Richard Richardson.

name: CWC Georgia State Championship
epitaph: The Georgia region's own top singles title, lost by Logan Gunz to Jimmy "Pretty Boy" Floyd through the wreckage of a timekeeper's table.

name: CWC Georgia State Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Georgia region's own tag title, won in a tournament final by Jason Wallace and Ben Mullins with the aid of a mace attack.

name: CWC Atlanta City Championship
epitaph: The Georgia region's own secondary singles title, defended by Aaron D'Arby against Neil Finan.

name: CWC National Championship
epitaph: The council's own alliance-wide title, contested in a tournament across all seven member regions that had not concluded as of the council's own served national newsletter.

name: CWC Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: The council's own alliance-wide cruiserweight title, contested in a tournament across the member regions that had not concluded as of the council's own served national newsletter.

name: CWC National TV Championship
epitaph: The council's own alliance-wide television title, announced for a match between Christopher Stonebreaker and an unnamed opponent in the council's own served national newsletter.

name: CWC National Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: The council's own alliance-wide tag title, announced for a match between the Overlords of the Dark and the Hot House in the council's own served national newsletter.
